overlap_accounting.independence_note: The blind generator independently reached the gap-through question (CORE-10) from the written producer fill predicate and the stage-history question (CORE-03) from lifecycle semantics - the two highest-value phenotype findings - without consuming any E1 outcome. Direction-asymmetry survival (D) was NOT blind-generated, consistent with it being an observed outcome rather than a semantic structure.

expansion_accounting.note: PD-A/DIR-01 add the stage-matched panel as a distinct E2 instrument; final multiplicity is computed at E2 contract freeze.

provenance.phenotype_derived: AP-002_E1_FINAL_METHOD_CHALLENGE question_generator_handoff item A (derived from E1 interpreter findings; challenger priority HIGHEST)
provenance.match_note: CORE-03 conditions outcomes on within-zone stage history (untouched vs already-touched-not-filled, stage age); SF-1 is the parameterized stage x horizon x stratum family. Neither references the observed sign pattern.

records.plain_language_question: Is the formation->touch sign change a genuine stage-conditioned effect after matching the same eligible population (within-zone matched anchors, matched clock offsets)?
records.justification: 18-neg/1-zero/2-pos (formation cohort) vs 21/21-positive (touch cohort) with outcome selection, anchor re-definition and horizon-clock shift confounded; no within-zone evidence exists; the E2 STAGE-MATCHED LIFECYCLE PANEL is the designated instrument.

provenance.phenotype_derived: AP-002_E1_FINAL_METHOD_CHALLENGE question_generator_handoff item B (derived from E1 interpreter findings; challenger priority HIGH)
provenance.match_note: CORE-03 covers stage-history conditioning; CORE-02 provides the session/time-matched conditioning axis with within-direction matched nulls. No blind question names a formation-stage control cohort as such.

records.plain_language_question: Does post-touch behavior differ from matched formation-stage and time-matched controls?
records.justification: Complements A with a between-zone matched control: rules out drift and calendar/session artifacts as the source of the 21/21 post-touch positive medians.

provenance.phenotype_derived: AP-002_E1_FINAL_METHOD_CHALLENGE question_generator_handoff item C (derived from E1 interpreter findings; challenger priority HIGH)
provenance.match_note: CORE-03's already-touched-not-filled state is the pre-fill baseline concept; no blind question specifies a matched pre-fill anchor contrast as such.

records.plain_language_question: Does post-fill behavior differ from matched pre-fill controls?
records.justification: FILL 21/21 positive but no pre-fill baseline anchor exists in E1B; 'continuation', 'neutralization' and 'reversion' labels are currently indistinguishable without it.

provenance.phenotype_derived: AP-002_E1_FINAL_METHOD_CHALLENGE question_generator_handoff item D (derived from E1 interpreter findings; challenger priority HIGHEST)
provenance.match_note: CORE-02 conditions direction on calendar session with within-direction matched nulls; CORE-12 tests sign robustness of same-domain structures. No blind question targets direction asymmetry survival specifically - correct blindness behavior, since the asymmetry is an observed outcome.

records.plain_language_question: Does the direction asymmetry (bullish 42/42 positive; bearish mostly zero/negative) survive direction-matched, time-matched, drift-aware nulls?
records.exposure_note: direction/time-matched controls and drift-aware nulls may require E3 cross-domain surfaces (session/time context); recorded per question
records.justification: The development window is upward-drifted (raw 41/42 positive across anchors), the direction-adjusted transform leaves drift residue under direction imbalance, and the formation population is bullish-skewed with scale (51.0%..60.5%); drift attribution is unresolved.

provenance.phenotype_derived: AP-002_E1_FINAL_METHOD_CHALLENGE question_generator_handoff item E (derived from E1 interpreter findings; challenger priority MEDIUM)
provenance.match_note: CORE-10 independently derives anomalous completion modes including fill-without-prior-touch from the written producer fill predicate (fill test independent of overlap), with no knowledge of the 1,010-case observation.

records.plain_language_question: Does gap-through fill differ from ordinary touch->fill after proper matching (direction/composition-matched, adequate-N strata)?
records.justification: 15s null vs 30s single-stratum contrast (n=213, 55.9% vs 51.1% bullish, wider IQR); no matched test exists; 5m-4h unmeasurable in-window.

provenance.phenotype_derived: AP-002_E1_FINAL_METHOD_CHALLENGE question_generator_handoff item F (derived from E1 interpreter findings; challenger priority MEDIUM)
provenance.match_note: CORE-01 conditions later-stage outcomes on formation-time magnitude attributes (gap in formation-ATR units, impulse body fraction); SF-2 is the attribute x horizon family.

records.plain_language_question: Do gap_atr or fvg_quality modify lifecycle duration or stage response?
records.justification: Median-split orderings are sign-unstable across anchors/horizons/strata and largest at smallest N; gap_atr p05 is floor-pinned at 0.2205-0.2294 vs min_gap_atr 0.2 (threshold-selected population); duration modification is untested and censor-aware estimation is required.

provenance.phenotype_derived: AP-002_E1_FINAL_METHOD_CHALLENGE question_generator_handoff item G (derived from E1 interpreter findings; challenger priority MEDIUM)
provenance.match_note: CORE-10's anomalous completion modes include zero-duration completion; no blind question isolates same-bar resolution as a distinct phenotype hypothesis.

records.plain_language_question: Does same-bar fill represent a distinct lifecycle phenotype (vs multi-bar touch->fill) after matching?
records.justification: 34.2-40.4% same-bar mass with p25=0 everywhere; geometric point-mass alternative unresolved; no committed outcome comparison between the two modes (P-04 QG3 registered, unmeasured).

provenance.director: Director mandatory selection audit (AP-002 E1 final challenge paste): recommend the exact E2/QG experiment separating stage-conditioned behavior from selection into touch/fill
provenance.match_note: The blind stage-conditioned family and stage-history core question occupy the same semantic cell without knowledge of the selection confound.

records.plain_language_question: E2 STAGE-MATCHED LIFECYCLE PANEL: within-zone matched formation-vs-first-touch contrasts at identical calendar offsets, censor-aware selection model of touched vs never-touched and filled vs touched-unfilled, time-matched no-FVG drift-aware null; pre-registered rule: stage-conditioned = within-zone sign change that also beats the null, selection-only = it vanishes.
records.justification: The only pre-registered instrument that can convert the cohort-pattern sign reversal into (or rule out) a stage effect; ordered by the director before any E1 freeze.
